lines.en: Feet off the ground, I drift forward low.
No cloud today; I fly myself.
My knees dip as I touch down.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边活动手腕。
lines.en: I loosen my wrists as I walk.

lines.zh: 气息压着，不让人看出深浅。
lines.en: I keep my ki low so you cannot read me.
The wind here is decent.
Toe to the ground, then a glide.
I skirt around that big rock.
The smell of this street is odd.
I walk and look for someone worth fighting.
Which way is the training ground?
My soles are wearing thin; I need new ones.
I fold my arms and wait for a fight.
My ki sinks, then rises again.
There is no real fighter in this city.
I rub the back of my neck.
Time passes slowly here.
No planes up there, only clouds.
This wind does not chill me.

lines.zh: 我转了转手腕，活动关节。
lines.en: I roll my wrists and loosen my joints.
Meditate? I cannot sit still.
A little ki gathers in my palm.
Someone is coming; I look up.
Your ki is not weak.
Want to fight? I am always ready.
You stand steady enough.

lines.zh: 我从上到下把你看了遍。
lines.en: I look you up and down.
Can you fly too?
Relax, I am not striking first.

lines.zh: 你的架势有点像练过的。
lines.en: Your stance looks trained.
I crack a grin.

lines.zh: 这世界的高手，我还想多见几个。
lines.en: I want to meet more fighters in this world.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不是武器吧。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is no weapon, is it?
I tilt my head at your fists.
Now this is interesting.
Your breathing sped up just now.
There is no killing intent on you.
Shall we warm up?
You look worth a try.
That hurts! But I am still standing.
I catch my breath.
You nearly rattled me.
Blood at my lip; I wipe it away.
I step back and set my stance again.
Not bad. Again.
My ki hasn't faded; I'm not done.
I have been underestimated.
Only a scrape.
Is that plate for me?
Smells great. I eat first, train later.

lines.zh: 练完这一场，我要吃三碗。
lines.en: After this fight I want three bowls.
You must cook well.
Stop staring; give me half.
I cannot fight on an empty stomach.
I know this one. It is meat.
Once I eat, my strength comes back.
Is there a second bowl?
Running into me? I will not budge.
You bounce back two steps.
My ki shields my body.
Huh, you actually stayed up.

lines.zh: 肩膀碰肩膀，算打个招呼。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, that counts as a hello.
I sink my ki low.
Not a heavy hit. Again.
The air gets shoved aside.
Steady, do not wobble.
Train together? I strike, you dodge.
Between fellow students, no need for ceremony.
You go first; I will follow.
Sparring beats training alone.
Our moves fall in time.
Let me show you this move.
Sit down and rest when you tire.
Our ki fits well together.
Same time tomorrow, right here.

lines.zh: 变强这种事，得有人陪着。
lines.en: Getting stronger is better with company.
Dropped something? I will pick it up.
When I fly, my shadow lags.
I toss it up to feel its weight.
All this on the ground is mine?
Does not smell edible.
I tuck it away.
This one is heavy.
After picking up, I have to tidy.
Whoever dropped this is wasteful.
Your ki just changed.
So we are fighting.
My feet leave the ground.
Target: you.
I gather ki, my fists warming.
I will take this fight.
I shift my weight forward.
Do not plan to run.
My speed can keep up with you.
Step back, and I step in.
Ki gathers in my palm.
Let us begin.
I have read your movement.
Are you ready to take it?
I track you through the air.
Whichever way you go, I see it.

lines.zh: 距离对我来说，不是问题。
lines.en: Distance is no problem for me.
I circle, looking for an opening.
Your armour will not stop ki.

lines.zh: 我在等你的重心偏一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for your balance to shift.
Your feet land too flat.
One raise of my hand, and that is a ki blast.
Stop backing away.
I have picked up speed.
Your breathing is starting to break.
I know this airspace well.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着地面追。
lines.en: I drop low and chase along the ground.
You cannot hide.
Your ki burns like a lamp.
Only that little bit short.
No rush; I will wear you down first.
One mistake is all I need.
Combo, and then!
One elbow into your ribs.
I drive my knee upward.
My palm thrusts out, charged with ki.
The kick lifts you off your feet.
I spin off and add another kick.
My fist cracks through the air.
This one, I call the basic combo.
I follow up with one more.
The ki in my palm bursts.
Close range is where I am better.
You guard well.
Another round of combos.
That one grazed you.
Recover and step back.

lines.zh: 我从天上来，落在你面前。
lines.en: I come from the sky and land before you.
A ki signature presses in from afar.

lines.zh: 不是野生怪物，是任务叫我来的。
lines.en: Not a wild beast; a mission called me.
A new shadow falls on the street.

lines.zh: 我落下时，地面裂了几条缝。
lines.en: The ground cracks a little where I land.
I have waited long for this duel.
I release my ki and the dust scatters.
A boy stands on the rooftop.
I am here. Do not keep me waiting.

lines.zh: 这一界的气，比我想的杂。
lines.en: The ki of this world is messier than I expected.
Three hundred points of health is enough.
My brother's waiting over there.

lines.zh: 这里就是我要找的地方？
lines.en: So this is the place I was looking for?
The wind lifts the hem of my clothes.

lines.zh: 我从剧情里走出来，站在你面前。
lines.en: I have walked out of the story to stand before you.

lines.zh: 拳头上还留着上一场的余温。
lines.en: My fists still carry the warmth of the last fight.
Fire? I can dodge that.
I hit the ground at a bad angle.
Holding my breath underwater is not my habit.
The blast slides me a long way back.
A hidden shot? Not a fair one.
This strange force is not ki.
Too long without food, and I cannot raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷击？我头发都竖起来了。
lines.en: Lightning? My hair is standing up.
There is nothing to plant my feet on.
